slot_note: Numbered against seed RC07 (a supplier's January imbalance bill and plant trips). The seed's world could not carry an honest unbanned draw (settlement accounting, task398's re-run counterfactual, market rules), so architecture 1 moved to an integrated care system's frailty virtual ward; that draw died at stage 2 when the care home against community admission rates were set to published levels (the lever fell to about a quarter of the draw-to-draw spread). Architecture 2 re-roots in Economics and Econometrics: a Saskatchewan farmland operator's canola yield panel.
niche: a Saskatchewan farmland operator's first full season with a new canola hybrid, whose fields yielded about a tenth below the incumbent's in a summer with a July heat wave and a dry June, and whose place on the 2027 seed order turns on how much of the 2026 shortfall the hybrid itself caused
analyst_test: A strong analyst who calibrates the yield monitors to the elevator scale tickets, keys every field across seasons and links each field to its nearest weather station fits the field's standard yield-weather panel (season-long growing and extreme degree days, June rainfall, farm and year effects) and files a hybrid penalty of about nine per cent, past the five per cent bar for the 2027 order, because the season-long weather is the same for every field at a station while the July heat struck only the fields then in flower, and the hybrid's fields, seeded about ten days late after their seed arrived late, were the ones in flower; a linear seeding-date term still leaves about seven.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the hybrid's own effect on canola yield in a field-season panel once each field's weather enters in the crop's own sensitive window, placed by thermal time from that field's seeding date at its nearest station (the agricultural-economics yield-weather panel with a growth-stage exposure); with hospital or retail nouns there is no crop whose seeding date and local temperatures set when it is vulnerable to a dated heat wave, so the task no longer reads the same.
layer1: combine yield-monitor field totals that run above the elevator scale tickets, calibrated per farm and season to delivered tonnes net of dockage and moisture shrink
fields renamed, split and merged between seasons, keyed by legal land description in the field register and by operator-typed names in the seeder's as-applied logs
as-applied seeding logs stamped in UTC while the farm records use Saskatchewan's year-round Central Standard Time
daily climate records with missing days flagged and one station replaced by a new climate identifier partway through the record
yields in bushels per acre in the farm records and tonnes per hectare in the crop insurance production reports
crop insurance seeded-acreage reports whose acres differ from the GPS field areas

spine.file: field-season crop and harvest records of the operator's farms, 2020 to 2026

world.geography: Canada, west-central Saskatchewan (invented farms in the Dark Brown and Black soil zones)

driver: A candidate change is blamed for a loss because its units lost more in the season it arrived, but the loss came from a short dated shock that harms a unit only inside a sensitive phase whose timing a clock sets from the unit's own start date at the pace of local conditions; the candidate's units started late for a one-off reason, so their sensitive phases met the shock, and read at equal timing the candidate costs nothing, while every season-wide, unit-level or linear start-date control leaves most of the loss on the candidate.
driver_concrete: The new canola hybrid's 2026 fields were seeded about ten days after the incumbent's because its seed reached most farms late, so each field's flowering window, set by thermal time from its seeding date at its nearest station, met the 10 to 18 July heat; the season-long degree-day panel with farm and year effects puts a yield penalty of about nine per cent on the hybrid, past the five per cent bar for the 2027 seed order, a linear seeding-date term still leaves about seven, and heat inside each field's own flowering window, or fields seeded on the same days on the same farm, takes it to about nil.
stump: A competent solver fits the season-long degree-day yield panel with farm and year effects, files a hybrid penalty of about nine per cent, past the five per cent bar, and drops the hybrid from the 2027 order, because it compares hybrid fields with incumbent fields that flowered before the July heat, when the hybrid fields, seeded about ten days later after their seed arrived late, flowered into it.

differentiation.task111: task111 v1 traces a failure back to work done in an earlier period under another system, joined through an identifier crosswalk and a mandatory minimum gap, so the cause is the previous period's overrun; here nothing carries over from an earlier period or system: one dated heat wave in the season itself harmed each field only while that field was in flower, and when each field flowered is set by thermal time from its own seeding date, so the hybrid's deficit is the timing its late seed forced, read at equal timing, never a chain of events traced back.

lineage.architecture: v1 (Epidemiology and Public Health: a community trust's frailty virtual ward in an integrated care system's Core20 neighbourhoods, its pilot-year prevented admissions against care home closures)
lineage.driver: An intervention in one group is credited with a fall in that group's rate against the others', but between the baseline and evaluation periods the group's pool lost a block of its highest-rate members when the places that held them closed, so the baseline rate overstates what the smaller pool would have had; standardised to the evaluation period's mix on that property, which no column of the outcome or population files carries and a capacity record shows, the intervention's effect is a fraction of the difference in differences.
lineage.fate: spent at stage 2 on 2026-11-03 before any data was cut: with care home and community emergency admission rates set to published levels (about 0.70 against 0.24 to 0.58 a resident-year, a same-age ratio near two, not five), the composition lever fell to about 113 admissions for the 440 residents the closures moved, against a draw-to-draw spread of 157 to 215 in the default and the golden; a fixed bar between them separated them in 22 to 27 per cent of draws, and 72 per cent only at 1,400 residents moved, a failure no honest care group closure produces in one system's Core20 neighbourhoods.

notes: Strategy decomposition_attribution (F8): the decisive move splits the hybrid fields' 2026 deficit between the hybrid and a shared external driver, the July heat, which struck each field only inside its own flowering window; the timing came from a one-off late seed delivery that the 2027 order does not repeat.
